def test_empty_data_with_maxcolwidths():
    from tabulate import tabulate

    # Empty data without headers
    result = tabulate([], maxcolwidths=[10, 20])
    assert result == ""

    # Empty data with headers
    result = tabulate([], headers=("A", "B"), maxcolwidths=[10, 20])
    assert isinstance(result, str)
